svg.aria-label: TCP connection life: SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK open the connection and agree on starting sequence numbers; data segments carry sequence numbers and cumulative ACKs; FIN and ACK in each direction close it.
svg.title: TCP connection life: SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK open the connection and agree on starting sequence numbers; data segments carry sequence numbers and cumulative ACKs; FIN and ACK in each direction close it.
svg.text: no ACK before the timeout (≈ RTT + 4 × deviation)? resend. 3 duplicate ACKs? resend at once
ACK (client waits 2 × max segment life, then closes)
